description: Armour weight (D592, D551: no stamina, so weight trades roll for defence), read by Scripts/Systems/ArmourWeight.gd. The worn body armour's items.json "weight" sets the class; no body armour is light. roll_length = share added to the roll's length; defense = flat Phys. Def. added to the equipment stats. Numbers are provisional (design/charms_plan.md), checked against verify_difficulty (D642).
